messages.snippet: James, The Hollencroft consent (change-of-control, c.18% of revenue) still hasn't come back. Options
messages.subject: Ironvale - Hollencroft consent risk
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

The Hollencroft consent (change-of-control, c.18% of revenue) still hasn't come back. Options: (a) make it a condition; (b) take it as a specific indemnity; or (c) Buyer waives and relies on W&I. Crestview seemed relaxed on the HoT call. What's your steer for the DD report conclusion?

Elena

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.snippet: Flag it as the key red flag but recommend Buyer waiver + W&I rather than a condition - Crestview won
messages.subject: RE: Ironvale - Hollencroft consent risk
messages.plaintextBody:
Flag it as the key red flag but recommend Buyer waiver + W&I rather than a condition - Crestview won't want a condition that gives Hollencroft leverage. Note it clearly in the DD report and we'll let Daniel Reeve decide.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
